scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/source/tsconfig.json packages/ai/tsconfig.json packages/playwright/tsconfig.json packages/recorder/tsconfig.json packages/voicevox/tsconfig.json packages/renderer/tsconfig.json packages/cli/tsconfig.json && node packages/cli/build.mjs
scripts.clean: find packages -name 'dist' -type d -exec rm -rf {} + ; find packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.release:check: pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm --filter auto-product-video-generator pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:npm: pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm --filter auto-product-video-generator publish --access public
